flagged.evidence: The title says “Exact dyadic Sturm isolation of all real roots of a rational polynomial,” but the Definition accepts any p in Q[x] and says that for p=0 it returns “identically zero”; “it has no finite list of isolated roots.” The unqualified title includes an input for which the procedure explicitly returns no isolation list.

The title says “Exact Sturm bisection isolates every distinct real rational-polynomial root.” The Statement limits the isolation guarantee to nonzero p and says that for p=0 the algorithm returns “identically zero,” not a finite isolation list. The title therefore exceeds the stated result’s domain.
